title: LicoUp user-interface interaction state machine
authority: User-visible states and expected operations; not generated from production navigation code, and containing no Dart class names, controllers, RPC or widget keys.
scope: Navigation, menus, feature windows and the Settings directory in both layouts; in the dashboard also group conversations, back, search input and results, dialog dismissal, refresh, scrolling and continuous cross-page operations. Declared transitions are enumerated and randomly walked; the report lists omissions and does not claim coverage of every product operation.
principles: A state is judged from what is actually visible; the presence of a button or a controller value change does not by itself prove that a transition succeeded.
The operation model is separate from the Flutter location adapter; an internal refactor changes only the adapter, and only a user-visible behaviour change changes this model.
One transition records the time from the action to the visible target together with its frame cost; an ordinary widget test does not stand in for on-device performance.
Only environments present on this machine are exercised; other devices are arranged by the developer.
Actions are chosen randomly from those currently visible and available, with the state context, the seed and the full sequence retained so a run can be replayed.
Declared-transition coverage is reported separately from whole-product coverage; a visible control with no declared transition is listed explicitly as an omission.
